[curious] What websites do gamers visit the most?
[excited] Number five, Steam. By far where all most of the best games are in!
[upbeat] Number four, Poki. Its a games platform run in the browser. It’s the place where people can play Mobile games on their browser!
[amazed] Number three, roblox.com. Probably the most played game platform of all time!
[dramatic pause] And finally Number two, It’s not even a gaming platform. It’s the only place where gamers can watch livestreams of every game being played! Twitch
